title: Colonialism on the Cheap: The French Empire 1830–1962
title_zh: 廉价殖民主义：法兰西帝国（1830–1962）
authors: Denis Cogneau, Yannick Dupraz, Elise Huillery, Sandrine Mesplé-Somps
abstract: How much did France pay for its colonial empire? Did colonies benefit from large transfers from French taxpayers and private investors, or were they, on the contrary, drained of their capital? This paper uses novel budgetary, private investment, and loan data to compute monetary flows between France and the colonies between 1833 and 1962. Public expenditure spent by France on the empire represented only 1.3 percent of its GDP, of which four-fifths was for the military. Trade balance deficits of French colonies were not counterbalanced by large public or private capital transfers from France to the colonies, but by military expenditure from the metropole. Overall, large sums of money were flowing from the colonies to the metropole, a “drain” representing a couple of percentage points of colonial GDP, making French colonies comparable to British India in the twentieth century.
abstract_zh: 法国为其殖民帝国付出了多少代价？殖民地是否从法国纳税人和私人投资者的大规模转移中获益，还是相反，其资本被抽空？本文利用1833年至1962年间法国与殖民地之间新的预算、私人投资和贷款数据，计算了双方的资金流动。法国在帝国上的公共支出仅占其GDP的1.3%，其中五分之四用于军事。法国殖民地的贸易逆差并未通过法国向殖民地的大规模公共或私人资本转移来弥补，而是由宗主国的军事支出所抵消。总体而言，大量资金从殖民地流向宗主国，这种“抽血”相当于殖民地GDP的几个百分点，使得法国殖民地在20世纪与英属印度具有可比性。

title: Agriculture and Natural Disasters: Evidence From the 2015 Nepal Earthquake
title_zh: 农业与自然灾害：来自2015年尼泊尔地震的证据
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the short‐ and long‐run effects of the 2015 Nepal Earthquake on paddy production using a difference‐in‐differences framework and district‐level panel data spanning 2010–2019. We document a 10.95% decline in paddy production and a 6.94% decline in yield in earthquake‐affected districts in the short run, with effects fully dissipating over the long run. Decomposing production losses into intensive and extensive margins reveals that the intensive margin explains the majority of losses. Heterogeneity analysis shows that production losses scale with seismic intensity while yield losses operate as a common behavioural shock uniformly across affected districts. Household survey evidence confirms two reinforcing channels: a contraction in agricultural labour supply during the critical planting season and a reallocation of household resources toward reconstruction of damaged dwellings.
abstract_zh: 本文采用双重差分框架及2010–2019年区级面板数据，考察2015年尼泊尔地震对水稻生产的短期与长期影响。研究发现，地震受灾地区的水稻产量在短期内下降10.95%，单产下降6.94%，但长期来看这些影响完全消散。将产量损失分解为集约边际与广延边际后发现，集约边际解释了大部分损失。异质性分析表明，产量损失随地震烈度递增，而单产损失则表现为受灾地区普遍存在的共同行为冲击。家户调查证据证实了两种相互强化的传导渠道：关键播种季节农业劳动力供给的收缩，以及家户资源向受损房屋重建的重新配置。

title: Engine Run, Quality Enhance: Examining the Effects of Energy Steady Supply on Chinese Export Product Quality
title_zh: 引擎运转，质量提升：能源稳定供应对中国出口产品质量的影响研究
authors: Yao Hu, Shan Shao, Hui Wang, Weifen Lin
abstract: ABSTRACT Oil is the lifeblood of industry, serving as the core source of power for the operation of industrial machinery. Ensuring its stable supply is crucial for the smooth production process, which in turn is a key determinant in enhancing the quality of export products for enterprises. This study empirically examines the impact of energy supply on the quality of export products and the mechanism of its effect by using a staggered difference‐in‐differences (DID) method with the implementation of China's West‐to‐East Oil Transportation Project as a quasi‐natural experiment. The empirical results show that a dependable energy supply substantially boosts the quality of goods produced for export by various companies. The mechanism analysis shows that energy supply improves export product quality through enterprise performance improvement effects, industry agglomeration effects and supply chain stabilization effects, and it mainly improves export product quality in energy‐importing regions, technology‐intensive industries, private enterprises, and general trade enterprises. Further analysis reveals that a stable supply of energy helps enhance the sustainability of enterprise exports while helping enterprises realize value chain upgrading, helping China get rid of the curse of locking the bottom of the export value chain. The findings of this study help clarify the intrinsic mechanism between energy supply and export product quality and provide an empirical basis for the cross‐regional energy dispatch strategy to help China's export value chain upgrade.
abstract_zh: 摘要 石油是工业的血液，是工业机械运转的核心动力来源。确保其稳定供应对于生产过程的顺利进行至关重要，而这又是提升企业出口产品质量的关键决定因素。本研究以中国“西油东送”工程实施为准自然实验，采用交错双重差分法实证检验了能源供应对出口产品质量的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，可靠的能源供应显著提升了各类企业的出口产品质量。机制分析显示，能源供应通过企业绩效提升效应、产业集聚效应和供应链稳定效应改善了出口产品质量，并且主要提升了能源输入地区、技术密集型行业、民营企业和一般贸易企业的出口产品质量。进一步分析发现，稳定的能源供应有助于增强企业出口的可持续性，同时帮助企业实现价值链升级，助力中国摆脱出口价值链低端锁定的困境。本研究结论有助于厘清能源供应与出口产品质量之间的内在机理，并为跨区域能源调度策略助力中国出口价值链升级提供经验依据。

title: Managing Monetary Policy Normalization
abstract: Abstract This paper develops a framework for monetary policy normalization in which liquidity conditions shape aggregate demand through a liquidity channel. The model implies that central bank balance sheet operations can stabilize demand even away from the zero lower bound, making reserves an independent policy instrument alongside interest rates. Optimal balance sheet size therefore depends not only on private reserve demand, but also on fiscal interactions and liquidity management. Following shocks that generate a liquidity trap, optimal policy expands reserves at the lower bound, initiates quantitative tightening before rate liftoff, and normalizes rates and reserves together, clarifying balance sheets’ stabilization role.

title: To Catch a Thief: Endogenous Policing and Choice of Location by Criminals
title_zh: 捉贼记：内生性警务与犯罪者的地点选择
authors: Siddhartha Bandyopadhyay, Antonio Cabrales, Kaustav Das, Siddhartha Bandyopadhyay; Antonio Cabrales; Kaustav Das
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a tractable model of offender location choice and police resource allocation across multiple areas. Individuals differ in the cost of apprehension and choose whether to commit crime and, if so, where. Each area contains a fixed value of criminal opportunities, so offenders impose congestion on one another, while policing affects expected apprehension. For arbitrary policing levels, equilibrium sorts offenders by apprehension cost across areas ordered by policing per unit of criminal opportunity value. With a fixed police budget, welfare maximization equalizes policing-to-value ratios across all active areas. The model shows when place-based policing should target the value of criminal opportunities rather than observed crime counts alone, since observed crime may already reflect prior police allocation and offender displacement.

title: Competitive Advertising and Pricing
authors: Ilwoo Hwang, Kyungmin Kim, Raphael Boleslavsky
abstract: Abstract We consider an oligopoly model in which each firm chooses not only its price but also its advertising strategy regarding how much, and what, product information to provide. To highlight firms' strategic incentives, we impose no structural restrictions on feasible advertising content, so that each firm can disclose or conceal any information. We obtain a comprehensive characterization of the equilibrium advertising strategy and provide some sufficient conditions for the existence of symmetric pure-price equilibria. We show that intense competition induces firms to provide accurate product information; firms usually obfuscate consumers' relatively low or high values; and requiring firms to provide more product information can reduce social surplus and also be harmful to consumers.

title: Irrigation investments and agricultural productivity in Northern China
authors: Zhuanlin Wang, Jinxia Wang, Kaixing Huang
abstract: Abstract Irrigation is widely recognized as a key driver of agricultural productivity and rural economic development, yet credible evidence on its impacts, mechanisms, and long‐term economic returns remains limited due to endogenous irrigation investments. Leveraging the timing of government irrigation investments and longitudinal household survey data spanning 15 years, we investigate how irrigation affects agricultural productivity. We find that irrigation investment increased the share of irrigated farmland by 11.0 percentage points, which in turn raised per‐area output by 14.9%, net agricultural income by 15.6%, agricultural total factor productivity by 13.7%, and per‐labor output by 36.2%. These effects are driven by four key mechanisms: increased use of high‐productivity inputs, expanded cultivation area, labor reallocation from farm work to off‐farm work, and mitigation of drought damage. The induced land expansion and labor reallocation explain the substantially larger increase in per‐labor output. A cost‐effectiveness analysis suggests a high return to irrigation investment, with approximately half of the return stemming from labor reallocation that increased off‐farm income. These results provide strong evidence that irrigation investment plays an important role in improving agricultural productivity and accelerating rural transformation, with benefits extending beyond the farm by influencing labor markets.
